text:
Explicit review revision of this unexecuted proposal. Preserve the accepted requirements exactly, including the sole query input, all output types, non-null row objects with nullable fields, maxItems 10, the exact workbook destination, no consent actions, truthful stopping on real blockers, and unconditional Browser closure. This authorizes restructuring only the data-adaptation and failure-routing composition necessary for the following corrections, using existing TaskPlan constructs. Preserve actual opening, search submission, result observation, each product visit, writing and cleanup, with their existing operation identities and contracts. Do not remove business work or add permissions.

1. Correct the reported invalid bindings. output(source, port) already selects that port: do not apply field(..., theSamePort) again. field selects an object property, never an array or scalar. Every requires must be boolean: use explicit non-null predicates for nullable references and conjunctions over producer completeness flags. Do not use a snapshot, selector, URL or TSV string as a condition. Check observationSnapshot presence, captureTruncated=false and manifestTruncated=false on the original producer data using correct declared paths. Do not delete necessary assertions or substitute constant true.
2. The unconditional search_blocked_value currently requires blocked=true and therefore fails the normal successful path. Correct this routing. An actually blocking obstacle must fail before affected operations and workbook publication, preserving cleanup and observed diagnostic facts. Do not convert a blocked/incomplete page into a fabricated empty product row or a successful workbook. Mere informational cookie links are not blockers. No acceptance, refusal, personalization or other consent interaction is authorized.
3. interpret_home must not receive the whole observationSnapshot. Insert a compact extract-mode each over its bounded complete pages. Declare only the immediate decision facts and offered candidate IDs in its resultType, retaining original action data separately. Apply the same bounded complete-page extraction composition to search results and product details. Do not feed a full snapshot to global interpretation or whole-snapshot learned extraction. Every page and record must be processed; no truncation, optional-candidate sampling or implicit collection filtering. Original completeness metadata remains authoritative.
4. For arrays of page-view objects, use a pure foreach to project arrays inside item, then flatten those exported arrays exactly one level. Group related exports in that scope. Do not field an array, and do not flatten an array of row objects. Interpretation selects candidate IDs only from compact offered observations; lookup validates offered IDs then reconnects original observed records. Action references, supported actions and URLs come from those records, never interpretation-generated arguments. Retain selected order and repeated selections. Keep producer-side action compatibility and snapshot validity checks.
5. Remove the unrequested organic/sponsored filtering instruction from extract_product_links. Preserve the first observed product ordering and the ten-product maximum without deduplication, sponsored exclusion or invented eligibility criteria. Selection belongs to the explicit compact decision, not hidden per-page truncation inside extraction.
6. Return one non-null typed row object per actually visited product, with permitted missing fields null, so direct loop collection retains maxItems 10. Use value/direct typed bindings for row copying and final assembly rather than combine_rows/select_final_state interpretation. Preserve every accepted output type; no invented fallback row, name or URL. The existing bounded TSV-formatting transform may remain over at most ten compact rows, retaining exact observed values and ordering. Remove its synthetic blocked-row instruction. productsFile must reference the successful writer's declared path output, never a literal standing in for a file. Do not change the accepted requirements to accommodate the implementation.

Use only current contracts and existing bindings, exports and scopes. No new operators, executors, schema fields, mapping mechanisms, runtime limits or approval bypass. Return a fully validated proposed TaskPlan for separate artifact review; nothing is approved for execution.
